boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Union College gatherings, ceremonies, sounds, and service traditions tied to campus life in Schenectady.

cards.title: Open the year at Convocation
cards.subtitle: September · Union College
cards.notes: Attend the community gathering that welcomes the new class, recognizes Dean’s List students, includes music, and ends with a community barbecue.
cards.short_summary: Union’s official opening-of-year ceremony combines welcome, recognition, music, and a barbecue.
cards.evidence_claim: Union identifies Convocation as the official start of the academic year, with the full community welcoming the new class, musical performances, Dean’s List recognition, and a concluding barbecue.
cards.access_notes: See Union’s current events and orientation information for attendance details.

cards.entity_name: John Calvin Toll Day of Community Engagement
cards.title: Join Toll Day’s community work
cards.subtitle: Fall service tradition · Schenectady and Capital Region
cards.notes: Register through the Kenney Center when offered, then work with local partners on ongoing projects while learning about community needs and culture.
cards.short_summary: A longstanding Union service day connecting campus volunteers with regional community projects.
cards.evidence_claim: Union calls John Calvin Toll Day of Community Engagement a longtime College tradition in which students work alongside local community members on projects across the region.
cards.source_title: Annual Events | Kenney Center | Union College
cards.access_notes: Participation depends on the annual program and project registration.

cards.title: Return for Homecoming and Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: October · Union College
cards.notes: Use the annual schedule to choose campus activities, food events, and the featured game; invite family or attend with friends as programming permits.
cards.short_summary: Union’s fall gathering blends family programming, campus activities, and a featured athletic game.
cards.evidence_claim: Union describes Homecoming and Family Weekend as an annual autumn gathering of the Union community with food, activities, and the anticipated big game.
cards.access_notes: Consult the current Homecoming and Family Weekend schedule for event-specific access.

cards.title: Mark the charter anniversary on Founders Day
cards.subtitle: February · Union College
cards.notes: Look for the annual program featuring a keynote, student musical performances, and recognition of educational accomplishments across the College.
cards.short_summary: The College commemorates its charter anniversary with talks, student music, and recognition.
cards.evidence_claim: Union states that Founders Day commemorates the anniversary of the College’s charter and features a distinguished keynote, student music, and recognition of accomplishments.
cards.access_notes: Check the annual Founders Day announcement for location and attendance information.

cards.title: See campus turn into ReUnion weekend
cards.subtitle: May · Union College
cards.notes: Follow the yearly ReUnion program for receptions, picnics, the parade, fireworks, and opportunities to reconnect across Union generations.
cards.short_summary: Union’s alumni-and-campus reunion weekend includes social events, a parade, picnics, and fireworks.
cards.evidence_claim: Union describes ReUnion as a weekend for alumni, students, faculty, staff, and friends with receptions, picnics, a parade, fireworks, and other activities.
cards.access_notes: Event access and any registration requirements vary by the annual ReUnion program.

cards.title: Watch the Commencement procession through the Nott
cards.subtitle: June · Nott Memorial and Schaffer Library
cards.notes: Use the College’s commencement information to view the ceremony, including the graduating procession through the Nott Memorial’s western door.
cards.short_summary: Graduates process through the Nott Memorial’s western door for Union’s June Commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: Union states that its June Commencement ceremonies, held in front of Schaffer Library, include a spirited procession through the Nott Memorial’s western door.
cards.access_notes: Follow the current Commencement schedule and campus access guidance.

cards.title: Volunteer at the Community Carnival
cards.subtitle: Union College campus · Schenectady
cards.notes: Sign up with the Kenney Center to help run games, crafts, sports, food service, or setup and cleanup for local families at this campus event.
cards.short_summary: A Union tradition that welcomes local families for games, crafts, sports, food, and volunteering.
cards.evidence_claim: Union calls Community Carnival a College tradition inviting local families to a free on-campus event with food, games, crafts, sports, and more.
cards.source_title: Annual Events | Kenney Center | Union College
cards.access_notes: The Kenney Center lists volunteer needs and annual event details.

cards.title: Spend a day with the Steinmetz Symposium
cards.subtitle: Annual student research and creative-work celebration
cards.notes: Review the current program, then attend presentations and displays that showcase Union students’ scholarly and creative work across disciplines.
cards.short_summary: Union’s interdisciplinary symposium highlights student research and creative work.
cards.evidence_claim: Union’s Steinmetz Symposium program identifies the event as an interdisciplinary tradition and celebration, established in 1991 to showcase student scholarly and creative work.
cards.access_notes: Use the current Steinmetz program for session times, locations, and attendance details.

cards.title: Listen for Memorial Chapel’s mechanical chimes
cards.subtitle: Memorial Chapel · Union College
cards.notes: Pause near Memorial Chapel during the day to hear the chimes, then look for special-occasion performances when the College announces them.
cards.short_summary: Union maintains mechanical Memorial Chapel bells as a century-old campus sound tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Union reports that Memorial Chapel’s chimes have sounded since the building opened in 1925 and that the College maintains mechanical bells rather than recordings or synthesizers.
cards.source_title: Soundtrack of a century: College chimes still sound a sweet note across campus | Union College
cards.access_notes: The chimes ring automatically; special manual performances depend on College programming.

cards.entity_name: Ode to Old Union President’s House Serenade
cards.title: Sing “Ode to Old Union” at the President’s House
cards.subtitle: Orientation tradition · President’s House
cards.notes: If included in orientation, gather with classmates at the President’s House and follow the program’s invitation to serenade the president with the alma mater.
cards.short_summary: Orientation programming brings students to the President’s House to sing Union’s alma mater.
cards.evidence_claim: Union’s Fall 2026 orientation schedule describes gathering at the President’s House to serenade President Kiss with “Ode to Old Union” as the return of a campus tradition.
cards.access_notes: This is listed in the Fall 2026 orientation schedule; participation is tied to orientation programming.
